description: Add a separate labeled, clickable URL (for example a restaurant Menu, online check-in, or directions link) to an ALREADY-EXISTING itinerary segment. Additive only: imported and existing links are never changed or removed, and an identical URL already on the segment is reported instead of duplicated. Find the segment first: call trips_list, then trip_details with sections ["segments"] on each candidate trip and match the segment by title or venue (keyword search can miss names), then confirm with the user. Returns the saved link and every link now on the segment.

label.description: Short button label shown for the link, such as "Menu", "Online Check-in", or "Directions".

link_type.description: Optional link category. Defaults to Other (use Other for menus and general websites).

segment_id.description: Segment ID (from trip_details/segment_details) to add the link to.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to add, such as a restaurant menu page.

name: segment_link_add
title: Add Link To Segment
